title: Verdict record
description: What one runner concluded about one judged tree: the output of the `judge-tree` Tool (cat-harness-tools#399). The tree is named by a digest, not a commit, so a verdict reached on an agent container, a local machine or GitHub Actions is the same verdict wherever the same tree recurs. Written by `scripts/judge-tree.ts`; validated by `validateVerdictRecord` in `scripts/lib/judge-tree.ts`, which implements exactly this schema.

treeDigest.description: sha256 of the judged tree: every instance of the index lock at its locked fixity digests, the caller's own entry replaced by its PR tree (`git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}`), and the judging-scripts version. See `treeDigest` in scripts/lib/judge-tree.ts.

judging.description: The judging-scripts version the digest was computed with: sha256 of `.github/scripts/layer-pr-checks/*.py` and the judge-tree scripts, unless the caller named one.

tree.description: What the digest was built from, for a reader; never consulted to decide anything.

exit.description: The gate's exit code; null exactly when it was skipped. 2 is 'could not determine', never a pass.

skipped.description: Why run-gates.py did not run it.

baseExit.description: The same gate's exit on the base side, when one was judged.

new.description: compare-gates.py counted it against this tree.

command.description: The command run, from the index root; what `--sample` re-runs.

new.description: Failing here and not on the base side (compare-test-failures.py).

failing.description: Each failing test as compare-test-failures.py names it (suites and case joined by ' > '), so this record can stand in as a later run's base.

base.description: Where the base side came from: a stored verdict for the base tree digest, a fresh run, or none (every failing gate then counts).

verdict.description: green: no gate or test newly fails. red: one does. unknown: the comparison could not determine (a compare script exited 2 or crashed, or no gate ran).
